title: Japanese-Style Cabbage Gratin
description: A twist on the classic French gratin, this dish combines Japanese flavors with the crunch of crispy cabbage.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cabbage and grated gratin.
In a small bowl, whisk together yummy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper.
Pour the sauce mixture over the cabbage mixture and toss to coat.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional gratin if desired.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the cabbage is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional sesame oil if desired.
